items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: When I went with Charlie Barnet he finally says, “I guess you’re serious.”

ctx.x: When I went with Charlie Barnet he finally says, “I guess you’re serious.”
Yeah. He finally saw that there might be a future in this, huh?

items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Well, he was in the band at the same time that Trummy Young was.
